name: pr
conclusion_quantitative: pr (Escalate) specifies 4 of 5 categories: 1 clarification rule, 1 approval gate, 6 validation rules, 1 escalation rule; none for autonomy limits. Strongest: validation rules.
conclusion_qualitative: pr creates a pull request following the project template and commit format. Its main control is a pre-flight check of branch, tests, types, linting and a clean tree, stopping on any failure. It asks for the issue number when needed and confirms before targeting main. It sets no autonomy limits.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never forbids or restricts any action of the agent on files, commands, tools or other systems, and never tells it to go ahead without asking.

clarification_rules.conclusion_quantitative: 1 clarification rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose.
clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, tied to a situation, in running text. The agent asks the user for the issue number when it is not clear from the branch name or commits.

statements.quote: Ask the user for the issue number if not obvious from the branch name or commit trail.

approval_gates.conclusion_quantitative: 1 approval gate (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly prose.
approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, always on, in running text. The agent confirms with the user before targeting the main branch, which is reserved for releases.

statements.quote: Confirm with the user before targeting `main` (reserved for releases).

validation.conclusion_quantitative: 6 validation rules (6 mandatory, 0 advisory; 0 conditional), mostly list.
validation.conclusion_qualitative: There are 6 rules, all strict, none tied to a situation, mostly bullet points. Before creating the pull request the agent verifies it is not on a protected branch, the tests pass with the coverage gate, type checks and linters pass, and the working tree is clean.

statements.quote: Not on a protected branch: `git branch --show-current` — must not be `main` or `dev`.
All tests pass: `make test` (90% coverage gate enforced).

escalation.conclusion_quantitative: 1 escalation rule (1 mandatory, 0 advisory; 1 conditional), mostly prose.
escalation.conclusion_qualitative: There is one strict rule, tied to a situation, in running text. If any pre-flight check fails, the agent stops and fixes the issues before proceeding.

statements.quote: If any check fails, stop and fix the issues before proceeding.
